item.coloph: kun gyi bcud bsdus gnad byang 'di/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' yis/ phyi rabs 'gro ba'i don ched du/ mi shig rdo rje rtsal la brgyud/ dad ldan grogs pos bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' srung bstan skyong rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
